extra_misconceptions.fact: Standard glasses lack side shields and impact-rated polycarbonate lenses, requiring ANSI Z87.1 safety goggles over prescription eyewear.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Regular prescription eyeglasses provide sufficient side protection when cutting metal robot shafts with a rotary tool.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Puffed lithium polymer cells indicate internal gas buildup from electrolyte decomposition and must be isolated in a fireproof container.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Swollen lithium polymer battery cells can be safely discharged and reused if their voltage still reads within normal limits.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Radio interference or code glitches can trigger sudden full-torque motor movement, so main battery power must be disconnected first.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Tightening a loose set screw on a live servo horn is safe as long as the transmitter joysticks remain centered.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Rotating spindles can snag glove fibers and pull fingers into the tooling, so operators must keep bare hands clear of spinning bits.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Knit work gloves improve grip safety when feeding aluminum stock into a spinning drill press or bench grinder.

extra_misconceptions.fact: A machine lacking onboard sensor processing and autonomous control loops is a remote-controlled vehicle rather than a true robot.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: A combat machine driven directly by joystick commands without sensor feedback qualifies as an autonomous robot.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Telerobots receive high-level supervisory goals from a human operator while executing local obstacle avoidance and stability routines.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Telerobots require a human operator to manually command every individual joint motor pulse in real time.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Continuous tracks distribute vehicle weight across a much larger contact patch than wheels, reducing sinkage on soft or uneven terrain.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Wheeled drivetrains exert lower ground pressure on soft mud or loose sand than continuous caterpillar tracks.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Legged locomotion requires continuous actuator torque to support chassis weight and swing limbs, using far more energy on smooth ground.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Multi-legged walking robots consume less battery power on flat paved floors than wheeled platforms of equal mass.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Without encoder or potentiometer feedback, heavier payloads slow down DC motors and cause cumulative position drift during timed moves.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Open-loop motor timing scripts maintain accurate robot arm positioning even when payload weight changes significantly.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Stepping down gear ratios multiplies output torque at the direct expense of rotational velocity, trading speed for lifting capacity.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Adding higher gear reduction to a manipulator joint increases both lifting torque and maximum rotational speed simultaneously.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Porous foam absorbs acoustic pulses and steep angles deflect echoes away from the receiver, causing false timeout readings in code.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Ultrasonic rangefinders measure accurate distances to soft angled foam surfaces just as reliably as flat metal walls.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Human-robot interfaces encompass telemetry displays, status LEDs, audio alerts, touchscreens, and supervisory software dashboards.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: A human-robot interface consists solely of the handheld game controller used to steer the drive base during matches.

extra_socratic_questions: What sequence of sensor readings and control outputs allows a robotic gripper to grasp a fragile object without crushing it?
Which mechanical property separates a three-axis planar arm from a six-degree-of-freedom industrial manipulator?

Why is an unmistakable hardware emergency-stop button required on a human-robot interface alongside software pause controls?

extra_misconceptions.fact: A true engineering notebook records chronological design sketches, failed prototypes, raw test data, and root-cause fixes as they happen.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: An engineering notebook should only contain clean final CAD drawings and working code written after the robot succeeds.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Modifying multiple variables at once masks which specific adjustment caused the performance change, invalidating the test comparison.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Changing motor speed, sensor threshold, and wheelbase length in the same test run speeds up robot debugging.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Shifting sunlight and overhead fixtures alter reflected light values, requiring dark-and-light threshold recalibration in the test area.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Ambient room lighting stays constant enough that a color sensor calibrated at noon will read identically at night.

extra_misconceptions.fact: As battery voltage drops during use, motors spin slower under timed delays, so closed-loop encoder or sensor feedback is essential.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Hardcoding fixed delay timers into a movement routine guarantees repeatable navigation across different battery charge levels.

extra_socratic_questions: Why should a Scout draft a state flowchart in the engineering notebook before writing motor control code?
What behavior difference appears when a line-following robot switches from bang-bang logic to proportional control?

Why is elevating the drive wheels on blocks necessary before running newly uploaded autonomous motor code?

extra_misconceptions.fact: Engineering verification requires multiple repeatable trials under consistent conditions to measure success rate and error variance.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: A single lucky trial where the robot completes the task once proves the system design is reliable and finished.

extra_misconceptions.fact: A thorough technical defense traces any live failure to a specific mechanical, electrical, or software root cause and proposes a fix.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Blaming unexpected demonstration failures on bad luck is sufficient when presenting an engineering notebook to a counselor.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Extra mass high on an arm shifts the center of gravity forward and increases joint torque load, requiring full-system trade-off analysis.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Adding heavier structural plates to fix a flexing arm link has no effect on drive base center of gravity or motor stall.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Counselors evaluate how you diagnosed failures and iterated on your prototype, making documented mistakes essential evidence of learning.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Erasing failed trial logs from the engineering notebook makes the final project review look more professional.

extra_socratic_questions: What pre-run checklist steps verify that sensor wiring and battery voltage match your documented baseline before a demo?

extra_misconceptions.fact: Major leagues like FIRST and VEX award top honors for engineering notebooks, outreach, gracious professionalism, and control design.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Youth robotics competitions only reward the team whose robot scores the highest point total on the playing field.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Successful robotics teams organize specialized subteams for CAD, programming, electrical wiring, scouting, strategy, and project budget.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Every member on a competitive robotics team works exclusively on mechanical assembly and driver practice.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Field referees re-check robot size and weight compliance throughout the tournament and disqualify uninspected or oversized modifications.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Teams may modify their robot beyond maximum frame perimeter limits once official pre-match inspection has concluded.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Alliance partners coordinate autonomous starting positions and scoring paths before each match to prevent collisions and maximize points.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Alliance partners in cooperative tournament formats keep their autonomous paths secret from their own teammates.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Many high-demand robotics technician and PLC integration roles hire graduates from two-year associate programs and trade certifications.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Every career in the robotics industry requires a four-year university degree in mechanical or electrical engineering.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Building production robots requires daily coordination between mechanical designers, embedded firmware coders, and safety test engineers.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Robotics engineers spend their entire career working alone at a desk without collaborating across other disciplines.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Community robotics clubs and makerspaces pool shared 3D printers, oscilloscopes, and mentors so hobbyists can build on a modest budget.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Joining a community makerspace or amateur robotics club requires owning thousands of dollars in personal machine tools.

extra_misconceptions.fact: Licensed professional engineers and certified automation specialists must complete ongoing training hours to maintain active credentials.
extra_misconceptions.misconception: Professional engineering licensure and safety certifications remain valid permanently without continuing education.
